title: Unfitted Hybrid High-Order Methods Stabilized by Polynomial Extension for Elliptic Interface Problems | SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis

In this work, we study the design and analysis of a novel hybrid high-order (HHO) method on unfitted meshes. HHO methods rely on a pair of unknowns, combining polynomials attached to the mesh faces and the mesh cells. In the unfitted framework, the interface can cut through the mesh cells in a very general fashion, and the polynomial unknowns are doubled in the cut cells
